scripts.api:seed: docker exec helprest-api bun run seed
scripts.app:nuke-android: cd helprest-app && rm -rf android && bun run prebuild:android
scripts.app:eas:build-apk-cloud: cd helprest-app && bunx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.app:eas:build-apk-local: cd helprest-app && bunx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview --local
scripts.app:eas:build-aab: cd helprest-app && bunx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production-aab
